Argument.Label: What is the &string you want to left pad?
Argument.Description: The input string that will be left-padded to the specified width.

Argument.Label: What do you want to use as padding &character?
Argument.Description: The character that will be used as padding. If you enter a value that has more than one character, only the first character will be used.

Argument.Label: How &wide do you want the string to be?
Argument.Description: Here you specify the width, in number of characters, of the output string.
